paragraphs: Chapter 519
142. Negotiations (5)
Kinzelo Headquarters.
As if the bitter loss in the Sota Desert wasn't enough, the atmosphere was not good due to another sudden conflict with the Chief. Only Bubar and Ainas were laughing and playing around.
"Ha, Lord Zephyrin. Using force again..."
"The Chief should have at least found some consciousness to control Lord Zephyrin, but he lost his energy again. This keeps happening. I think I should say something too, Deputy Chief."
As Bishkel and Velakt spoke with frustration, Jo nodded his head.
"No, if he's a great demon, he's a great demon. Isn't this too much? He said he spat out a mouthful of blood!"
"Jo, don't butt in and shut up. Do I really have to tell you to shut up every time so you can keep your mouth shut? Do you want me to break your jaw so you can never speak again?"

"Um, Lord Zephyrin must have had no choice. Wouldn't Lord Zephyrin be the one who wishes for the Chief's recovery more than anyone else among us? He must be frustrated, being in a similar situation to Jin Kyung's Murakan family."
"Hmm, that's true. Marjiella."

At times like this, Jo found it difficult to hide his absurdity. If he had said exactly the same thing as Marjiella without a single mistake, Velakt would have attacked him for saying such an out-of-line remark.
'Tsk, a narrow-minded, dog-like, dirty, and smelly supremacist Suen!'
The moment Jo thought that, Marjiella turned her head and met his eyes.
'Don't think bad thoughts, Lord Jo!'
She then showed her mouth shape like this, and Jo coughed with his hair standing on end.
Creak!
The door opened. It was Zephyrin who entered.
"Have you arrived, Lord Zephyrin!"
Everyone sitting down stood up at once and saluted.
"Ah, the Grand Duke... has arrived. This kind of thing... should... listen to my words... come."
Zephyrin waved her hand at the standing people as if annoyed and signaled them to sit down.
"Don't say that, sister! Grand Duke Zephyrin, you've arrived? We were all talking about the Grand Duke."
"What did you say? What?"
"Oh, what we were talking about. We were all talking about Grand Duke Zephyrin."
"We were saying how amazing you are. Going to find the enemy alone is a burden for us lower beings. You've been through a lot, Lord Zephyrin."
Bishkel quickly interrupted Ainas's words and changed the subject. He had noticed that Zephyrin was in a very low mood.
Velakt, who had said he would speak up, only sighed as he saw Zephyrin's atmosphere and 'face.'
'Damn, I'm a great warrior, and I'm looking at this mood. Why is his jaw like that...? Did he really get hit?'
Zephyrin's jaw was severely swollen.
"Uhahaha, but Your Highness! Where did you get such a bump? Will a story come out if it bursts?"
In contrast, Ainas, who had been warned once, carelessly touched her swollen jaw and laughed.
Of course, the huge bump was caused by getting hit by Talaris.
"Ah, Ainas... Don't do that. His Highness might get angry..."
"Hehe, I've never seen such a big bump before! Sister! Sister, you should touch it too."
"Ah... No, no... I said no, you crazy girl! Just die! What are you doing to His Highness? Die! Die!"
Bubarubarak!
Suddenly, Bianca transformed, spitting out a combination of fists and curses like a machine gun. Ainas flinched, but Bianca already had a club formed in her hand and chased after her.
Marjiella rolled her wheelchair and approached Zephyrin.
"Um, what happened, Lord Zephyrin?"

"...We decided to have a negotiation, Marjiella. Jin Gyeong will inform us of the date, and we will analyze the items at the negotiation table. All the information we find out at that time must be shared, including with that damned General Jin Runcandel."
"Wow, that's quite a harvest!"
"Do you really think so?"
"Of course, if someone else from our side had gone, we wouldn't have gotten anything."
In the meantime, Bianca, who had been circling around the executives, regained her composure.
"Ah... What have I done? I'm sorry... It must have hurt, Ainas."
"Ah, uh, it's okay... But what's this smell? Your Highness, did you eat something over there? It smells delicious."
This time, Bianca sniffed around Zephyrin as well.
After the beating, Zephyrin had eaten at Tikan and returned. It seemed inappropriate for a demon lord to refuse a meal in such a situation, so she had no choice.
'Ah... Why were those cookies so annoyingly delicious, and the strawberry pie too...'
As Zephyrin took out the Litra cookies sshe had brought, the Caligo sisters immediately took a bite and expressed their joy by jumping around.
In other words, it was a mess.
Bishkel couldn't help but feel bitter and sad about how Kinzelo had ended up like this.
"Shall I tell you an interesting story for the gloomy Lord Zephyrin?"
Charrururuk, Marjiella rolled her wheelchair and spoke.
"What is it?"
"Maybe soon, something sad will happen to Jin Gyeong, Lord Zephyrin."
"A sad event...?"
Marjiella grinned.
"Hmm, they ate a lot. They even took all the cookies I had saved for the kids."
"But I protected the strawberry pie, Jet. I couldn't help eating at the table because of the strawberry pie, but at least I saved the pie. Yes."
"You're the best, Murakan!"
After the feast, the group gathered in small groups to chat or smoke.
Talaris was examining the blueprints and machines, having heard about everything that happened in the Sota Desert.

"Hmm, we'll need some proper magic translation specialists for these blueprints. This encryption magic is probably a new type created by Zipple. As for the machine... that prophet guy said it could change the course of battle?"
"Yes, Lord Talaris."
"I can understand if it's the story of the Black King's cannon that absorbs magic or something, but I have no idea how such a small object could be used?"
So far, all of Jin's colleagues and helpers had the same reaction.
"I thought so too. But as I kept thinking, I began to wonder if it had something to do with the cubic summoning device used by Zipple in the Gaifa Army."

"It seems Aria Owlhart, the last survivor of Hister, and Misha will be the key. I'm not sure if it's possible to decrypt the blueprint's code using record magic, but we should at least be able to find out who made the machine, right?"
"I think so too."
"And as for the code decryption, it would be nice if Kinzelo did it all... but Black Dragon Misha, she seems like she could help as well."
"I haven't been able to contact Misha. It's been a year. I'm starting to get a little worried."
The last time Jin met Misha was around this time last year. He had visited her after returning from the second tomb of Temar to ask about the record device.
At that time, Jin received information from Misha that 'Aria Owlhart is in Mamit,' which naturally led to his reunion with Valeria.

"A year, huh? That's not much time for a dragon, so you don't have to worry, son-in-law. She didn't seem like someone who would get caught easily when we fought together. I'd like to have a drink with Misha as a fellow soldier."

"Yes, little one. Bighoonju is right. That devil will show up when the time comes, so let's not worry about it at all. Huh? Ugh, I get goosebumps just thinking about her face. And she's not perfect either. She's good at shady things like code decryption, but she fails a lot too."
"Hehe, my handsome brother has a really scary sister, huh?"
"Heh, would she be scary?"
"Ah, so you're actually worried, aren't you?"
"If you knew that devil as well as I do, you'd realize how futile worrying is. If she decides to hide, even the gods can't find her, let alone humans."
"Well, we don't know since the Demon Stone combines the powers of several gods. Brother, you need to be a little more honest."

"Be quiet. Anyway, I think it would be more helpful to find a genius magic engineer sooner rather than later, even if it's not Misha. Both for improving the Black King's equipment and for figuring out that unidentified machine."
"We need a magic engineer, and we also need to meet Misha. There's a lot to do."
After realizing the need for a magic engineer, Jin had been diligently searching through his past life's memories.
He was trying to recall if there were any real genius magic engineers he knew who weren't affiliated with Zipple or the royal family at this point.
'Ramos Phil? Ah, he was already a member of the Royal Academy when I was a reserve knight. Hopper Newman? No. The Sailer family... they only existed until the early 1700s, right?'
Magic engineering had been one of the lowest-ranking interests in Jin's magic studies.
As a result, he didn't have many memorable figures, and most of them were either dead or already affiliated with a group.
"A genius magic engineer, huh... I've had a few lovers who were like that. Should I try contacting them? Son-in-law."
"Your lover? I don't have much confidence in them, Talaris. And did you have a taste for such slippery people?"
"I'd appreciate it if you could, Talaris. I plan to meet with all the unaffiliated magic engineers for now."
"Alright, but there's a condition. You have to call me mother-in-law."
"Of course, mother-in-law. I should definitely call you mother-in-law, considering how much you've done for me."
"Jin, you too!"
Syris's eyes widened in surprise.
"Ahaha, as expected! Our son-in-law is the only one who properly reacts to my jokes today! Everyone else just frowns. Hahaha!"
Talaris and Jin burst into laughter.
'Do my mother and Jin find this so funny? But I can't help but laugh too. Is it because of the lively and friendly atmosphere?'
Syris tried hard to suppress the smile forming on her face.
"Oh, son-in-law, look at that. She's about to laugh too. Do you know, son-in-law? When she was young, she used to call herself the Ice Princess."
"Ice Princess... No, Ice Princess, Syris? How old was she when this happened?"
"Ha? Are you an Ice Princess? Our little girl is the Black Crown Prince. Have you heard of it? The Black, Crown, Prince of Runcandel."
"Black Crown Prince? Lame. Ice Princess sounds better, Jin."
Eventually, Syris burst into laughter and responded to them, thinking it was nice.
After laughing and chatting for a while, Talaris tidied up her hair and stood up.
"Ahaha, thanks to my son-in-law, I had a good laugh."
"Are you leaving, Talaris?"
"Yes, it's time to go."
"I'll prepare to see you off."
"The son-in-law should go too."
"You mean with the Infinite?"
"Yes. Specifically, to the Infinite training ground."
"Why the Infinite training ground?"
"Your sister, Mary Runcandel, received a secret book written by Chiron himself. I, as the mother-in-law, will personally help with the attribute completion. It's the price for my laughter."
